notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Patch 0.1.2 is completely focused on improving the core mechanics and fix a number of bugs.


Changelog

This list will contain all new features, improvements ánd bug fixes.


Features

 Added a sample resource element in the scene which you can destroy to gain some EXP and points


Improvements

 Stance switching is disabled for now, defensive stance will be used to accomodate best gameplay. Will come back in an improved way
 Improved unit obscuring by other elements like trees, buildings etc


Fixes

 Fixed melee attack behaviour ( sometimes did not attack or only when you told it explicitly )
 Fixed range attack behaviour  ( sometimes did not attack or only when you told it explicitly )
 Fixed overall unit and stance behaviour: when you have an unit in defensive stance, it will not leave it's location
 Fixed unit and formation control. Units will follow your instruction and tend to be less busy with their environment ( especially if on defensive )
 Fixed enemy spawn animation and timings

notes.title: Release 0.1.0 for All cats 'r belong to us
notes.notes:
I'm very happy to share the release notes for version 0.1.0 which is available as a playable demo right now!


Upgrade system rewrite
This version contains a full reimplementation of the way we handle upgrades.
Here's a summary of the biggest changes since 0.0.3:


 Units no longer come in predefined classes. Instead, you determine what composition you want to build
 Upgrades are now applied on a single unit. 
 New recruits will always start as a blank sheet, only equipped with it's wits and a stick.
 Upgrades now come in two categories
  1. Equipment: Equipment determines what attributes and skills an unit gains. 
  2. Buffs: Will improve one attribute
  Picking upgrades now clearly shows what you gain



Ofcourse, this is not all we have to offer! Our music composer also provided us with the first track for the OST. You can listen at this awesome track here: OST - Track 1 on Soundcloud




Changelog

This list will contain all new features, improvements ánd bug fixes.

Features


 First track of our OST , which is called "For the Cats!"
 First version of the logo 
 Crash reporting (internal) 
 Different hair variations
 New card layout, displaying costs, an icon for visual representation and a description mentioning what the upgrade means
 Reroll button when the selected cards are not what you were looking for ( reroll has a small costs, which increases with each use )
 Added the Wishlist button in the menu
 Added an exit game button in the main menu 
 Implemented Shields, one-handed weapons (sword) and bows upgrades
 Implemented Dual-wielding of one-handed weapons ( give an unit 2 swords! )
 Implemented first attribute upgrades ( + maximum health )
 Introduced damage text on enemies. This will display the amount of damage delivered
 Added skip button on upgrade panel ( save up EXP )
 Implemented Taunt skill, acquired by equipping a Shield
 Implemented "Defense" attribute. Offers damage reduction to damage ( offered by shield or other gear later )

 Implemented Wands (1h) equipment
 Implemented Heal/Spell power attributes
 Implemented "Single heal" skill, acquired by equipping a Healing wand




Improvements


 Zooming out has been extended by about 10%
 Add glow to hovered unit when picking a victim for your upgrade
 Improved unit reaction to enemy presence
 Improved particle efffect for Taunt skill 
 Improved zoom sensitivity
 Added icons for all attributes
 Improved the Unit selection panel. Visuals are updated, Attributes are shown and skills are displayed
 Improved particle effect for Heal-related skills



Fixes


 improved billboarding system, units looked a bit "wrangled" due to a miscalculation 
 Fixed the unit hover effect while applying a buff or new weapon
 Fixed several errors which lowered overall FPS
 Updated card to allow for up to 4 upgrades ( previously overlapped )
 Fixed an issue where dropped loot would spawn under the terrain.
